map.alt: Painted winter map of the Sonnenfels mountain resort and village

investigators.name: Mara Keller
investigators.description: A Central European investigator experienced in scene reconstruction and long-form witness interviews.

locations.name: Winter Garden
locations.description: The glass heart of Sonnenfels, joining the hotel wings beneath iron ribs, palms, and winter condensation.

locations.name: Grand Hotel
locations.description: The restored sanatorium's grand public rooms, guest floors, offices, and service corridors.

locations.name: Thermal Baths
locations.description: Stone bathing rooms and steaming pools on the lower resort terrace.

locations.name: East Residence
locations.description: A domestic wing of individual flats overlooking the lower terraces.

locations.name: Restoration Workshop
locations.description: Timber sheds, covered work bays, and a service court behind the hotel.

locations.name: Architect's Lodging
locations.description: A modest chalet set apart from the main buildings beside the upper service road.

locations.name: Funicular Station
locations.description: The railway connection between Sonnenfels' upper terrace and the village below.

locations.name: Village Café
locations.description: A warm ground-floor café facing the old village square and funicular road.

locations.name: Municipal Reading Room
locations.description: A small formal civic building with public records, local papers, and quiet reading tables.

locations.name: Gardener's Cottage
locations.description: The working garden compound beside dormant beds and service greenhouses.

locations.name: Panorama Pavilion
locations.description: A glazed Belle Époque hall standing alone above the eastern mountain view.

locations.name: Police & Medical Rooms
locations.description: A practical municipal building shared by local police and medical services.
